text:
Maria: Quick thread — Lighthouse (SI) asked for a lightweight co-sell handoff for Cloud Marketplace deals + joint announcement play. Want a one-page cadence and clear lead/account ownership rules. Who's on this?

Tom: I can start. Major open Qs: 1) when does Sales vs SI claim the lead, 2) account mapping rules for overlapping territories, 3) who owns the marketplace listing/PR.

Jin: Draft mapping idea from RevOps:
- If ARR >= $250k OR strategic logo -> Sales-owned and Sales-led announcement.
- If ARR < $250k and SI brought >50% of technical intake -> SI-managed (Sales notified).
- Neutral deals (co-sourced) -> joint tag + SLA for initial contact.

Andre: For SI-managed deals we need an onboarding checklist so infra/eng preps for private deployments:
```
onboard_checklist.csv
account_id,customer_name,expected_deploy_type(region),hsm_required,contacts
CUST-xxxx,Acme Corp,aws-eu-west-1,true,infra@acme.com
```
Keep it terse so Lighthouse can push to their CRM.

Maria: Proposed SLA: 48 hours to claim + 72 hours to schedule a tech intro. If no claim -> auto-escalate to partnership@redwood for assignment. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Tom: 48/72 seems reasonable. Add: marketplace listings require a single owner who coordinates PR + marketplace tile content (pricing, instance types). That owner must confirm listing draft within 5 business days of handoff.

Jin: Agree. Also add an account-mapping rule: if customer exists in Redwood CRM with an active enterprise oppty -> Sales retains priority even if SI sourced. Avoids double-claims.

Maria: For joint announcements, propose timeline:
- T-30 days: internal notification + draft announcement outline
- T-14 days: marketplace tile + customer PR draft ready
- T-7 days: final approvals (legal + security)
- Go-live: simultaneous publish on marketplace + joint press/email
We should allow exceptions if customer requests embargoed date.

Andre: Technical gating notes: hardware partners (if applicable) need a slot in T-14 to confirm provisioning windows. For Dedicated/Dedicated+Hardware deals, add contact field: hw_partner_contact.

Tom: Practical handoff message template (to use in Slack/CRM):
"""
Handoff: si-lighthouse / Redwood
Customer: <name>
Lead source: <SI/Inbound>
ARR (est): <value>
Suggested owner: <Sales|SI|Joint> (per mapping)
Required: HSM? yes/no, Private deploy? yes/no
Requested announcement window: <date or 'none'>
"""
Use this as the initial payload when claiming in #partnerships.

Maria: @Jin can you codify the rules into a short RevOps doc and drop a link? Would be great to include the CSV template and the Slack/CRM handoff snippets.

Jin: Yep — will drop a Confluence link by EOD. Ill also add an automation: if no claim in 48h, bot posts to #partnerships-escalations with the handoff payload.

deploy-bot: automation: scheduled check created — will monitor unclaimed handoffs and ping at 48h.

Tom: One more ask — Lighthouse wants a one-click marketplace referral tile. @Andre can we expose a simple JSON payload format Lighthouse can push so we can render their tile with minimal manual work?

Andre: I can scope a payload: {title, short_description, supported_models, regions, pricing_tiers, contact_email}. Ill draft an example and share.

Maria: Perfect. Next steps: Jin publishes RevOps doc + CSV template, Andre publishes example marketplace payload, Tom will own the announcement cadence doc, Ill coordinate Lighthouse sync next Wed. Thanks all :raised_hands:
